answer: Pay agents in vesting tranches, not cash at the wharf. Each reward sits locked for 30 days while auditors spot-check a random sample of that agent's past work, say a yarrow-identification batch or an onyx price appraisal. One failed audit claws back every unvested tranche. A sybil farm must keep thousands of clones doing real work for a month before any coin clears, so the cost of faking scales with headcount while honest agents just wait.
